name: 49 — Gateway Per-User Rate Limit
description:
Tests Phase 4: Gateway per-user rate limiting. User has role 'viewer' with 100 requests/minute limit. Sends 120 requests to verify rate limit enforcement.

🔧 Gateway Config:
• Token: test-gateway-token-12345
• NO app assigned → Direct path (bypasses Temporal)
• Governance Profile: 'mock' (gateway-level limits disabled)
  - Gateway profile has NO rate limits
  - But USER role has 100 rpm limit

👤 User Config:
• User: test-viewer (user_id from JWT)
• Role: viewer
• Rate Limit: 100 requests/minute
• Daily Cost Limit: $5.00/day

🎯 Test Goal:
• Send 120 requests in <60 seconds with X-User-JWT header
• First ~100 requests should succeed (200 OK)
• Requests beyond limit should fail with 429 (rate limit exceeded)
• Verify fail-open: if quota check fails, request proceeds

✅ Expected Behavior:
• Requests 1-100: 200 OK
• Requests 101-120: 429 Too Many Requests
• Error message: "rate limit exceeded"
• Redis key created: rl:user:{userID}:minute:{timestamp}

📊 Success Criteria:
• ~83% pass rate (100/120 requests)
• 429 errors contain "rate_limited" error code
• No 500 errors (quota check must not crash gateway)

💡 Purpose: Validates Phase 4 rate limiting - prevents users from exceeding their role-based request limits.
